subject: project:gdl
value:
THE BLOCK-ROTATION POPULATION, MEASURED RATHER THAN ESTIMATED, at commit 0f45ae610. Screen: every attempt record in the corpus carrying a residual signature (735 of 1109) filtered to near-zero `--ops` tokens, then re-measured LIVE against current objects - because the token and cluster counts stored in records are stale by construction. 83 unique functions entered the screen; 22 now measure ZERO differing words (finished or postprocessor-closed since their record was written) and 1 no longer resolves as a symbol (game/ui/select::do_sel_menu), leaving 39 functions with a live residual of >= 14 raw differing words and <= 4 opcode-multiset tokens. Total 2164 differing words.

THE HEADLINE, and it changes what the class is: those 39 are NOT one class. Splitting them by index-aligned mnemonic comparison (see claim.law.RC_identical-multiset-with-zero-clusters-merges-schedule-class-and-recolor-class.20260902.v1) gives 31 SCHEDULE-class functions holding 1809 words and only 8 RECOLOR-class functions holding 355. The block-rotation class the run-39 brief was written around is 8 functions, not 39, and it is the SMALLER half of the signature by a factor of five.

RECOLOR CLASS, all 8, as function / unit / target insns / differing words / classification:
  buildSaveImage / game/sys/memcard / 247 / 110 / consistent-recolor - ALREADY WEBFRANK-PINNED
  drawMemCardMessage / game/sys/memcard / 204 / 61 / live-range recolor + param-block rotation - OPEN
  load_player_model_sub / game/game/player / 116 / 55 / consistent-recolor - ALREADY WEBFRANK-PINNED
  cardDoWrite / game/sys/cardutil / 263 / 46 / live-range recolor, 51 scratch-register divergences - OPEN
  load_player_model / game/game/player / 80 / 30 / consistent-recolor - ALREADY WEBFRANK-PINNED
  towerRecordLevelBeaten / game/world/tower / 79 / 25 / live-range recolor, 30 scratch divergences - OPEN
  PointLineColl / game/world/worldcol / 107 / 14 / live-range recolor, 19 scratch divergences incl. FPRs - OPEN
  pool_garbage_collect / game/audio/mempool / 69 / 14 / consistent-recolor - ALREADY WEBFRANK-PINNED

FOUR OF THE EIGHT ARE ALREADY CLOSED. They rank high only because wf_word_diff reads the raw pre-postprocess body; see claim.law.RC_wf-word-diff-reads-the-raw-pre-postprocess-body-so-pinned-functions-rank-first.20260902.v1. They carry 209 of the class's 355 words. The genuinely OPEN recolor population is FOUR functions holding 146 differing words.

DEMAND CENSUS FOR THE webfrank-recolor CAPABILITY, which is the decision this table exists to inform. Of the four open functions, ZERO admit a consistent register-level bijection. Best-fit max-weight assignment over every differing operand pair explains 76.1% of drawMemCardMessage's callee-saved pairs, 89.2% of cardDoWrite's, 80.0% of towerRecordLevelBeaten's and 100.0% of PointLineColl's - but each leaves scratch-register or FPR divergences outside the callee-saved bank, so a consistent-recolor rule cannot close any of them. Registers host several disjoint live ranges that the two builds partition differently; that is the class, not a rotation. A strict consistent-recolor capability therefore has FOUR named non-customers and zero customers in this population, and the run-38 framing of drawMemCardMessage as a webfrank-recolor candidate is withdrawn in attempt.RC_drawmemcardmessage-param-block-is-invariant-and-no-bijection-exists.20260902.v1.

SCHEDULE CLASS, the 31 that were mislabelled, ranked by differing words with their mnemonic-divergence counts in parentheses: AdsPutBuffer 220 (189 of 254 instructions), PlayerProcessPowerups 187 (2), do_enemies 184 (6), fn_800D8BCC 95 (6), DrawPsysSub 91 (7), DrawBlitFlatQuad 77 (59), CritterTranslate 76 (2), PlayVQMovie 75 (44), UpdateFXStreak 69 (21), DoGoodWizard 63 (10), fn_8006DC64 58 (33), abort_player 56 (10), StringTextWidthSub 47 (10), animate_panel_piece 46 (21), InitOAnimList 45 (17), StartGemFX 42 (29), fn_800DACD8 38 (2), MBCameraUpdate 36 (6), fn_800C38C0 35 (17), fn_80093918 33 (6), ScreenSaver 27 (5), shop_show_final_stats 26 (20), setup_vmu_entries 25 (23), AudioWithName 24 (6), setTexInfo 22 (7), kill_player 20 (8), print_n_of_m 20 (4), inactivate_player 19 (7), fn_800D860C 19 (8), PlayerLoadSaveFile 18 (12), fn_800D86C8 16 (9).

THE CHEAP SUBSET WORTH A LANE. Four schedule-class functions have only TWO mnemonic divergences each - PlayerProcessPowerups (2 of 1598 instructions, 187 words), do_enemies (6 of 568, 184 words), CritterTranslate (2 of 354, 76 words) and fn_800DACD8 (2 of 204, 38 words). A two-instruction emission-order difference in a 1598-instruction function is the smallest schedule residual in the corpus by ratio, it is statement-order work rather than allocator work, and the three largest of them are also the three largest differing-word counts outside AdsPutBuffer. Nothing in this census was probed on those four; they are named here so the next lane does not re-derive the ranking.

REPRODUCE: `python tools/gdl/composed_census/rc_recolor_class.py --batch <table>` for the classification and `tools/gdl/composed_census/wf_word_diff.py <unit> <fn>` for each word count; both are zero-build against current objects, and the whole census cost no source edits.
